explanation: Jean was a sturdy cloth named after Genoa, Gênes in French. Denim was named after a French city too: serge de Nîmes, cloth of Nîmes.

claims.text: The word 'jeans' comes from jean, a sturdy twilled cloth named after Genoa (French Gênes).
Jeans are not named after Venice, Naples or Trieste.
Denim comes from French serge de Nîmes, a fabric named after the city of Nîmes.
